description: Retrospective application for the erection of a two and three storey marketing suite for a temporary period (five years), with landscaping and associated works
decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted (000 Rev. D, 002 Rev. F, 003 Rev. F, 004 Rev. E, 005 Rev. E, 006 Rev. F, 007 Rev. F, 008 Rev. F, 009 Rev. F, SITE Rev. E, 055_L100 Rev. P1, Design and Access Statement dated 15 February 2019, EcoWorld-Kew Marketing Suite-February 2019-Version 6. Received: 21/02/2019) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 2 - The permission hereby granted shall be for a limited period expiring five years from the date of this permission when the use shall cease, the structure removed and the land restored to its previous condition.

Condition : 3 - The use hereby permitted for a marketing suite shall not be carried on outside the following times unless otherwise as agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority: Monday to Fridays 9am-6pm and Saturdays 10am-4pm.
